relationship.statement: A pendulum's period depends only on its length and gravity, not on the bob's mass. Longer pendulums swing slower, while stronger gravity makes them swing faster.
assumptions: The release angle is small (15 degrees), so the small-angle approximation holds.
The rod is massless and rigid, and there is no air resistance or friction.

quantities.label: Rod length
quantities.meaning: Distance from the pivot to the center of the pendulum bob.

quantities.label: Bob mass
quantities.meaning: Mass of the hanging pendulum bob.

quantities.label: Period
quantities.meaning: Time required for one complete back-and-forth swing.

quantities.label: Angle
quantities.meaning: Current angle of the pendulum from vertical.

quantities.label: Gravity
quantities.meaning: Acceleration due to gravity in the chosen environment.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { var g = 9.81; if (inputs.gravity === 'moon') g = 1.62; else if (inputs.gravity === 'jupiter') g = 24.79; var L = inputs.length; var period = 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L / g); var maxAngleDeg = 15; var angleDeg = maxAngleDeg * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI / period) * t); var angleRad = angleDeg * Math.PI / 180; var pivotY = 4.2; var bobX = L * Math.sin(angleRad); var bobY = pivotY - L * Math.cos(angleRad); var bobSize = 0.2 + (inputs.mass - 0.5) / 4.5 * 0.7; return { period: period, angleDeg: angleDeg, gravityVal: g, bobX: bobX, bobY: bobY, bobSize: bobSize, isMoon: inputs.gravity === 'moon', isJupiter: inputs.gravity === 'jupiter' }; }

outputs.meaning: True when Moon gravity is selected
True when Jupiter gravity is selected

always: Mass changes bob size, not period.

cases.text: Weak Moon gravity slows the swing.
Strong Jupiter gravity speeds it up.

explanation.otherwise: Longer rods take more time to swing.

lesson.title: What changes a pendulum swing?
lesson.description: Watch a pendulum swing back and forth while its angle is plotted over time. Test how rod length, bob mass, and gravity affect the period of each swing.
lesson.instructions: Adjust the rod length, bob mass, and planet gravity sliders. Watch the period readout and the angle-versus-time graph to see which changes alter the swing time.
lesson.goal: Discover that a pendulum's period depends on its length and gravity, but not on its mass.
